title: Personal Records experience separated from Admin Panel (frontend)

requirements.summary: Move personal-record management out of the Admin Panel into a dedicated signed-in Personal Records experience, while keeping Admin Panel admin-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel UI only uses admin-only record queries/mutations and does not call personal-record APIs.
The non-admin area (Records view) provides a user-facing UI to view and manage the signed-in user’s personal records (list + detail + create/edit/delete) using the new personal-record APIs.
If the user is not signed in (Internet Identity), the Records view shows a clear sign-in prompt and does not show any records.

file_operations.description: Wire the Records view to render the new Personal Records experience instead of the current static admin-only message page; keep Admin Panel navigation intact so Admin Panel remains separate from Personal Records.

Replace the current admin-only explanatory content with a Personal Records page that: (1) shows a clear Internet Identity sign-in prompt when unauthenticated, and (2) when authenticated, renders the personal-record list/detail and create/edit/delete UI. Use the authorization system via the existing Internet Identity hook (selected component: authorization) for gated access; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable login/logout button for the Personal Records page using the existing Internet Identity hook and clearing React Query cache on logout (selected component: authorization). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small wrapper component that shows the sign-in prompt (with AuthButton) when the user is not authenticated, and renders children only when authenticated (selected component: authorization). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Adjust header/subtitle wording if needed so the primary non-admin experience is clearly 'Personal Records' (English-only copy), without introducing new top-level routes.

requirements.summary: Add dedicated React Query hooks/mutations for personal-record CRUD with separate cache keys and smooth UI updates + graceful authorization error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: There are separate React Query cache keys for admin records and personal records (no shared cache keys).
Creating/updating a personal record immediately reflects in the personal records list and the selected detail view without requiring a manual reload.
Authorization errors for personal-record actions are handled gracefully in the UI (English messaging).

file_operations.description: Implement React Query hooks for personal records that call the backend personal-record capabilities (e.g., reading the caller’s personal record) using cache keys that are distinct from admin records (e.g., not ['admin-records']). Ensure hooks are enabled only when an actor is available and the user is authenticated (selected component: authorization). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement React Query mutations for create/update/delete personal record using the backend personal-record capabilities, with separate cache keys and optimistic/update-on-success behavior so list + detail refresh immediately. Handle authorization failures gracefully (English) (selected components: authorization, blob-storage for ExternalBlob image uploads via direct URL). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Keep existing mutations explicitly scoped to admin-record flows only; ensure they continue to update only the admin cache key(s) and do not share personal-record cache keys (no cross-invalidation).

Make the form usable for both admin and personal flows by allowing the parent page to control submit behavior and error messaging; ensure displayed messages remain English and do not assume admin-only authorization on failure.

Ensure detail rendering supports personal-record usage (e.g., readOnly mode when appropriate) and that authorization/failed action states can be surfaced cleanly by the parent page (English-only messaging).
